How to use this calculator

  1. Enter values.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How statistics is calculated

Mean is sum/n; median is the center of the sorted values; range is max−min. Quartiles use the median-of-halves convention, excluding the overall median for odd-sized lists. For 1, 2, 2, 5, the mean is 2.5, median is 2, mode is 2, and range is 4.

Mean=Σx/n; median is the center of sorted data; range=max−min.
A worked example

For 1, 2, 2, 5, the mean is 2.5, median is 2, mode is 2, and range is 4.

Assumptions & useful context

The result depends on the values you enter and the method described above. Displayed numbers may be rounded; calculations use the unrounded values. Check that this model matches your situation before relying on it.

Frequently asked questions

How are tied modes shown?

Every value with the highest frequency is listed.

Does this perform an inferential test?

No; it summarizes the entered observations and does not account for study design.
